name: JUGLANS CINEREA
key_symptoms: Atonic dyspepsia with much eructation and flatulent distention. Soreness in region of liver.
Dull, full head. Eruption on scalp. Sharp, occipital headache. Head feels enlarged. Pustules on lids and around eyes.
Muscles of neck rigid, lame. Pain between scapula and under right. Pain in lumbar vertebrć.
guiding_symptoms: Atonic dyspepsia with much eructation and flatulent distention. Soreness in region of liver.
Dull, full head. Eruption on scalp. Sharp, occipital headache. Head feels enlarged. Pustules on lids and around eyes.
Muscles of neck rigid, lame. Pain between scapula and under right. Pain in lumbar vertebrć.

better: getting heated, exercise, scratching, on rising in morning

head_symptoms: Dull, full head. Eruption on scalp. Sharp, occipital headache. Head feels enlarged. Pustules on lids and around eyes.
gi_symptoms: Atonic dyspepsia with much eructation and flatulent distention. Soreness in region of liver.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Muscles of neck rigid, lame. Pain between scapula and under right. Pain in lumbar vertebrć.
skin_symptoms: Red, like flush of scarlatina. Jaundice, with pain about liver and right scapula. Itching and pricking when heated. Pustules. Eczema, especially on lower extremities, sacrum and hands. Erythema and erysipelatous redness.
